rationale: Brent (FRED daily, aggregated to monthly) as driver and PUDL/EIA-923 oil delivered fuel cost (freq=M, ends 2026-05-01) as response, both as pct_change to remove common trends, with up to 30 days of lead to test the sub-one-month pass-through; caveats: monthly n is small (~15 points), the war-driven Brent spike is a common cause, and receipt costs reflect contract timing.
